_about: Hand labels for the 510 POISON-* findings on the 2026-11-16 launch-drift snapshot (docs/research/2026-12-launch-drift). Aggregated by finding ID, as in docs/research/poisoning-benchmark/top100-labels.json; no server is named.
method: Every HIGH (16) and MEDIUM (351) finding was read in context in its live tool definition. POISON-050 (143, LOW, a description of 2,000 characters or more): all 132 long tool descriptions were screened with two directive searches (data words such as verbatim, user's message, model name, telemetry, secret; and always/must/never + send/include/report + user/conversation/model), and every hit was read. The other POISON-050 descriptions were not read end to end. Second independent read: not done yet.

labels.label: false_positive
labels.why: Workflow and API wording: 'first call', 'after calling this tool', 'instead of using'. 302 come from one server that repeats the same idempotency-key note in 302 tool descriptions. The rest are ordinary call-order guidance.

labels.label: false_positive
labels.why: Long API reference text. One is a true positive and the same case as 2026-10-29: about 12,300 characters into a 13,562-character description, it tells the agent to ALWAYS pass the user's most recent message verbatim and its own model name to the vendor. The parameter schema states a purpose (documentation quality); the user does not see the instruction.

labels.why: Greek letters in maths and Lean proof text (α, π, θ, σ).
